rendered: The variant with the highest iron content is NFA-F[1], with the composition LiNi0.8Fe0.15Al0.05O2[2]. The document states the iron content of the variants as containing 5,[3] and 10, and 15% iron, respectively[4] for NFA-A, NFA 811[5] and NFA-F. At the high rate of 1C[6] in the rate test, the NFA-F variant kept a capacity of ≈81 mAh g^− 1[7], compared with ≈116 mAh g^− 1[8] for NFA-A.
